post.description:
Validate parameters, compute the edits and commit them as a Revision (or dry-run).

An Operation that needs review is a 409 `review-required` unless the request names a
`task`: then it runs on a task branch and the answer is 202 with the Proposal.

202.description: The Operation needs review and ran on a task branch; a Proposal carries the edits (`status`: `proposed`, `merged` or `conflicts`).

409.description: Review required (`review-required`, with `next` hints), head moved (`stale-head`), idempotency key reused with other parameters (`idempotency-conflict`) or too many task branches (`agent-branch-limit`).

422.description: Invalid parameters or violations (`issues`, `edits`), a precondition that does not hold (`precondition-failed`, with the expression and its position), or expressions not enabled (`expressions-not-enabled`).
